2609.12860.title: 3D CT-to-PET Translation via Latent Brownian Bridge Diffusion
2609.12860.paper_summary: Computed tomography (CT) and positron emission tomography (PET) provide complementary anatomical and functional information for cancer diagnosis and treatment planning. However, the widespread use of PET is limited by high radiation exposure, elevated costs, and restricted availability. To address these limitations, deep learning-based CT-to-PET translation has emerged as a promising approach for synthesizing PET-like information directly from CT images, although accurately modeling the large cross-modal gap remains challenging. In this work, we propose a 3D CT-to-PET translation framework based on latent Brownian Bridge Diffusion (BBDM). The method consists of two stages. First, a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) is trained on paired CT-PET patches, integrating contrastive learning to improve latent alignment between anatomical and metabolic representations. Second, a BBDM is trained in the latent space to translate CT latent representations into their corresponding PET counterparts. The translated PET latents are then decoded and stitched to reconstruct the final 3D PET volume. We evaluate the proposed approach on two publicly available datasets. Quantitative results based on image fidelity and lesion-level PET-specific metrics demonstrate improved performance compared with competing methods. In particular, the proposed approach improves PET signal fidelity, better preserves clinically relevant uptake patterns, and shows improved performance in preserving small-lesion metabolic activation, paving the way for virtual imaging applications.
2609.12860.paper_summary_zh: 計算機斷層掃描 (CT) 和正電子發射斷層掃描 (PET) 為癌症診斷和治療規劃提供了互補的解剖和功能信息。<lb/>然而，PET 的廣泛使用受到高輻射暴露、成本上升和可用性限制的影響。<lb/>為了應對這些限制，基於深度學習的 CT 到 PET 轉換已成為一種有前景的方法，能夠直接從 CT 圖像合成類似 PET 的信息，儘管準確建模這一大型跨模態差距仍然具有挑戰性。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了一種基於潛在布朗橋擴散 (BBDM) 的 3D CT 到 PET 轉換框架。<lb/>該方法由兩個階段組成。<lb/>首先，對配對的 CT-PET 補丁進行變分自編碼器 (VAE) 訓練，整合對比學習以改善解剖和代謝表示之間的潛在對齊。<lb/>其次，在潛在空間中訓練 BBDM，將 CT 潛在表示轉換為其對應的 PET 對應物。<lb/>然後將轉換後的 PET 潛在表示解碼並拼接，以重建最終的 3D PET 體積。<lb/>我們在兩個公開可用的數據集上評估了所提出的方法。<lb/>基於圖像保真度和病變級別的 PET 特定指標的定量結果顯示，與競爭方法相比，性能有所改善。<lb/>特別是，所提出的方法改善了 PET 信號的保真度，更好地保留了臨床相關的攝取模式，並在保留小病變代謝活性方面顯示出改進的性能，為虛擬成像應用鋪平了道路。
